method: Read complete text-rendered public pages: Rent lines0–72 and Bond lines0–111. No HTML select inspection or result submission. No hidden input values inferred from displayed outputs.

verified_inputs: monthly debt repayment (car/student loan, credit cards etc.)
rent.verified_scope: The introductory text says estimated affordable monthly rent depends on income AND debt level.

ratio_discussion.summary: Affordability is explicitly described as relative. Examples of views people hold are25% or33% front-end debt-to-income. Neither number is identified as the calculator algorithm.

rent.recommendation_ratio: unknown; no explicit algorithm in page text
rent.debt_effect_formula: unknown; debt is an input but page does not state its coefficient or whether debt subtracts from gross income or housing+debt cap
rent.safe_maximum_rent_bands: unknown; no safe/maximum band formula or output is visible in the fetched unsubmitted page
do_not_claim: Do not label25%,30%,33%,36% or40% of income as source-verified calculator policy.
Do not cite30% in roommate or HUD paragraphs as the affordability calculation; those paragraphs discuss other contexts.
Do not infer income/debt defaults or thresholds from absent calculator results.
rent.next_verification: Inspect actual HTML to obtain input names/options, then submit controlled zero-debt and positive-debt cases at identical income; record output bands. This research does not establish a replacement formula.

coupon_date_mode.rule: Input four of price, face, yield, maturity years and annual coupon to solve remaining variable.
coupon_date_mode.scope: Fixed-rate coupon bonds on coupon date.

dated_mode.scope: Fixed-rate coupon bonds between coupon dates.

frequency_options.html_select_enumeration: unknown; prose says these are common frequencies, not an exhaustive select listing

bond.coupon_unit_selector_options: unknown; selector exists but text renderer does not expose values

day_count_definitions.30/360: 30days/month,360days/year; described as bond basis, often US corporate/agency/municipal.
day_count_definitions.Actual/365: Actual elapsed days with fixed365 denominator; prose notes leap366 usually not accounted for.
day_count_definitions.Actual/Actual: Actual accrual days and actual year length; identified primarily with government/Treasury bonds.

bond.february_30_360_adjustment: not specified; do not infer USNASD versus30E versusISDA from generic bond-basis name alone
bond.actual_actual_variant: not specified; ICMA/ISDA/AFB distinction not documented
bond.coupon_schedule_anchor: not specified beyond supplied maturity date
bond.verified_identity: dirty price = clean price + accrued interest

numeric_examples.mapping_warning: Local coupon field may expect dollar amount or percentage depending coupon_unit; inspect field definitions before constructing fixture.

bond.source_inconsistency: Lines51–52 call yield current yield (coupon/price), while the explicit numeric example lines69–74 uses required discount yield6%/2 and discounted redemption. Treat discount-yield formula as supported by worked example; do not replace with current yield merely to follow inconsistent prose.
bond.excluded_default_outputs: 97.3270,97.3743,97.3326,.0417 and3days are displayed but their hidden default inputs are unavailable, so they are not complete numeric fixtures.
